text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates

text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
author: Seneca

text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
author: Seneca

text: We need never be ashamed of our tears.
author: Charles Dickens

text: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
author: William Shakespeare

text: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me.
author: Charlotte Brontë

text: Nothing is so painful to the human mind as a great and sudden change.
author: Mary Shelley

text: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton

text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
author: Emily Dickinson

text: I am large, I contain multitudes.
author: Walt Whitman

text: The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a heaven of hell, a hell of heaven.
author: John Milton

text: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: What is now proved was once only imagined.
author: William Blake

text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

text: If we have our own why of life, we shall put up with almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
